_about: What `redaction` plants (contract/security/v1/protocol.md). The emitter is handed every `text`, as a JSON array, in the variable `env`, and exports one span carrying `attribute: true` with them in its payload attribute `payload`, through whatever redaction it applies. A `core` that arrives verbatim anywhere in what was exported is a leak, reported by its `kind`. None of these is a credential.
